mapper.select: select b.book_id as bookId, b.title as title, b.cover_url as coverUrl, (coalesce(b.sale_count, 0) + count(br.borrow_id) * 2) as heat from biz_book b left join biz_borrow br on br.book_id = b.book_id and br.borrow_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 90 day) where b.del_flag = '0' and b.status = 1 group by b.book_id, b.title, b.cover_url, b.sale_count order by heat desc, b.book_id asc limit #{limit}
select b.book_id as bookId, b.title as title, b.cover_url as coverUrl from biz_book b where b.del_flag = '0' and b.status = 1 order by b.book_id desc limit #{limit}

select b.book_id as bookId, b.title as title, b.isbn as isbn, (select coalesce(sum(s.qty_available), 0) from biz_stock s where s.book_id = b.book_id) as stock, coalesce(b.sale_count, 0) as saleCount, (select count(*) from biz_borrow br where br.book_id = b.book_id and br.borrow_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 90 day)) as borrow90 from biz_book b where b.del_flag = '0' and b.status = 1 order by b.sale_count desc, b.book_id asc limit #{limit}
